name: Café Restaurant Forellenhof
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Café Restaurant Forellenhof in Tirol Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the Alps.
beschreibung: The Café Restaurant Forellenhof in the Außerfern region is known for its fresh culinary offerings, highlighting traditional Tyrolean cuisine and fresh local fish specialties, particularly trout. Nestled in picturesque alpine scenery, the restaurant features a cozy dining room and a scenic sun terrace. Guests appreciate the attentive hospitality, fresh regional ingredients, and homemade cakes, making it a wonderful destination for hikers, families, and gourmets.
